# Bar popularity regression: results (generated by bar_popularity_regression.py)

Seed 42. Data: Yelp Open Dataset, 5,406 open bars (categories include Bars and Nightlife; is_open = 1; price level and noise level recorded). Outcome: review_count. v1 = OLS on log(1 + reviews).

## Split

| part | rows | mean reviews |
|---|---|---|
| train | 3,784 | 193.36 |
| test | 1,622 | 205.26 |

## Baseline vs v1 on the test rows

| metric | baseline (training mean) | v1 |
|---|---|---|
| R² (log scale) | -0.263 | 0.332 |
| R² (reviews) | -0.002 | 0.041 |
| RMSE (reviews) | 301.33 | 294.81 |
| MAE (reviews) | 172.24 | 136.04 |
| median abs error (reviews) | 130.36 | 56.74 |

Adjusted R², training fit (log scale): 0.344. R² log scale train 0.349 vs test 0.332.

## Bounty decisions on the test bars (threshold 233 reviews)

| cell | meaning | baseline | v1 |
|---|---|---|---|
| TP | popular, bounty | 0 | 86 |
| FP | not popular, bounty | 0 | 68 |
| FN | popular, no bounty | 415 | 329 |
| TN | not popular, no bounty | 1207 | 1139 |

## Decision for the example new bar

Input: `example_new_bar.json`. Output: `{"predicted_reviews": 82.1, "scout_bounty": false, "threshold_reviews": 233.0}`

## Value per month for a launch neighbourhood (all inputs are ASSUMPTIONS)

- ASSUMPTION bars_in_launch_neighbourhood: 200
- ASSUMPTION bounty_cost_usd_per_bar_month: 150.0
- ASSUMPTION value_fresh_info_popular_bar_usd_month: 400.0
- ASSUMPTION value_fresh_info_other_bar_usd_month: 50.0

| rule | bounties / month | USD per bar | USD per month |
|---|---|---|---|
| baseline | 0.0 | 0.0 | 0.00 |
| v1 | 19.0 | 9.063 | 1,812.58 |
| v1 - baseline | | | +1,812.58 |
